metric.purpose: Metric tile numbers, in blue, tabular numerals.

headline.purpose: Section headings; a larger step voices the footer call to action.

lede.purpose: Hero one-liner (ink-soft) and the About first paragraph (ink).

subtitle.purpose: Role titles, small card headings, Toolkit group headings.

body.purpose: Paragraphs at a 66ch measure; 16px on phones.

label.purpose: Problem / Decision / Outcome terms and chat speaker names; sentence case.

shadows.name: primary-lift

shadows.name: status-halo

motion.name: reduced-motion

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled action in a group; the only shadow at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.97rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s ease, background .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #2F6FEB); color: var(--accent-ink, #FFFFFF); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(17 24 39 / .12), 0 6px 16px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #2F6FEB) 60%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2F6FEB); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined white button for every other action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #E5E7EB); background: var(--bg, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #111827); font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.97rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface, #F7F8FA); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink-faint, #6B7280) 50%, var(--line, #E5E7EB)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2F6FEB); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Expand Button
components.description: Reveals more of a role; CSS chevron flips when open.
components.css: .ds-more { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #E5E7EB); background: var(--bg, #FFFFFF); font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.93rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #111827); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease; } .ds-more::after { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-right: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor; transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(45deg); transition: transform .2s ease; } .ds-more[aria-expanded="true"]::after { transform: translateY(2px) rotate(-135deg); } .ds-more:hover { background: var(--surface, #F7F8FA); } .ds-more:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2F6FEB); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Hairline pill with the green availability dot; hero only.

components.name: Result Chip
components.description: Pill restating a measurable outcome under a case study.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 100px; background: var(--accent-tint, #EEF3FE); color: var(--accent-strong, #1D4ED8); }

components.name: Metric Tile

components.css: .ds-sugg { font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.93rem; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 100px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #E5E7EB); background: var(--bg, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #111827); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-sugg:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #2F6FEB); color: var(--accent, #2F6FEB); } } .ds-sugg:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2F6FEB); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
A personal portfolio played straight: the category standard, finished at Read.cv clarity and Stripe craft. The person comes first (a status pill, the name at display size, one plain sentence), then the proof (four metric tiles, a role timeline of case-study cards), then a way to talk (an inline chat and an email card). Nothing is themed. The world is a white page, cool near-black ink, one confident blue, and one typeface, and it earns its polish through spacing, tight bold headings, and soft rounded containers rather than decoration.

Density is relaxed and readable. Sections breathe on a wide vertical rhythm, text holds a comfortable measure, and containers are either hairline-bordered white cards or borderless cool-grey tiles. Blue is reserved for action and evidence, so a scan of any screen lands on the buttons and the numbers. Dark mode is a full peer of light mode, not an afterthought: every color token has a dark value tuned for contrast.

This world replaces an earlier warm-paper "decision memo" treatment that was rejected as too serious. It carries no serif, no paper texture, and no warm accent.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, cool ink, one blue accent; green appears only as the status dot.
Figtree for everything, bold and tightly tracked at heading sizes.
Soft rounded geometry: 10px controls, 16px cards and tiles, 24px large panels, pills for status and tags.
Flat by default; the primary button is the only surface with a shadow at rest.
A timeline whose role details stay in view while case-study cards scroll past.
Full dark mode through `prefers-color-scheme`; print maps everything to black on white.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only hue that carries emphasis. No second accent, no gradients, no colored section backgrounds. Green exists only as the status dot.

rules.name: The Proof Is Blue Rule
rules.body: Accent-colored text marks evidence or action: numbers, outcome labels, result chips, links you can use. Body copy never turns blue for decoration.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Figtree only. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, tracking, and color, never from a second typeface.

rules.name: The Tighten As You Grow Rule
rules.body: Tracking scales with size: -0.01em at subtitle size down to -0.045em at display size. Body text stays at normal tracking.

rules.name: The Sticky Meta Rule
rules.body: Context holds still while evidence scrolls: role details stay pinned beside their case studies on wide screens.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: One shadow per screen at rest, and it belongs to the primary action. Cards, tiles, pills, and panels stay flat; they separate by hairline or fill, never by drop shadow. Shadows are soft and blurred; never a hard offset.

rules.name: The Radius Follows Role Rule
rules.body: Controls get 10px, containers get 16px, tags and status get pills. A new element takes the radius of its role; it does not invent a new one.

dos: Do keep blue for action and evidence only: buttons, metric numbers, outcome labels, result chips, usable links, focus.
Do set every heading in Figtree 700 with negative tracking that tightens as size grows.
Do separate containers with a 1px hairline or a Cool Surface fill.
Do give controls 10px corners, containers 16px, and tags or status a pill.
Do collapse a layout slot that has no content (the hero drops to one column without a portrait).
Do keep hit areas at 44px minimum and scope hover color changes to `hover: hover` where a tap would leave them stuck.
Do define a dark value for every new color token, and a print override for it.
Do keep accent text at 4.5:1 or better against its own ground at body and label sizes.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue, gradients, or colored section backgrounds.
Don't introduce a second typeface, a serif, or uppercase letterspaced labels.
Don't put shadows on cards, tiles, or pills, and never use a hard offset shadow.
Don't place a small label or kicker above a section heading; section context goes in the faint meta on the heading's baseline, and it states a fact.
Don't use glyph or emoji icons; draw small marks in CSS or inline SVG.
Don't lighten Ink Faint below its current value or use it for body copy.
Don't bring back warm paper, Newsreader, or vermilion; that direction was rejected.
